sentences.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
sentences.zh: 该公司欢迎使用其产品的消费者提供反馈。

sentences.en: Fadil received an overwhelming amount of feedback about his video.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔收到了关于他的视频大量涌入的反馈。

sentences.en: I'm waiting to see what kind of feedback I get.
sentences.zh: 我等着看我会收到什么反馈。

senses.zh: 反馈；反馈的意见（或信息）
